evidence.title: Claims Of China Being The First Country To Land On The South ...
evidence.snippet_en: A fact check by BOOM Fact Check rated as false the claim that China was the first country to land on the moon's South Pole a few years ago.

outputs.notes_en: The claim is about Chandrayaan-3's successful landing near the Moon's south pole, making India the first country to land in that region. The only relevant fact check directly addresses a claim that contradicts this, stating that China was the first to land on the moon's South Pole, which was rated false. Other fact checks are about fake videos/images or unrelated criticisms of the mission, not the core claim of the landing itself.
